skills.signature_strength: Find the actual abnormality and stop after verified recovery.
skills.countercheck: Test recurrence, hidden scope, and whether recovery only hid the signal.

skills.signature_strength: Turn an uncertain choice into runnable evidence quickly.
skills.failure_mode: Lets prototype success conceal production debt.
skills.countercheck: Require a stabilization gate before adoption.

skills.signature_strength: Expose speculative complexity with a tiny complete baseline.
skills.failure_mode: Drops intrinsic complexity along with accidental complexity.
skills.countercheck: Stress the baseline against safety, domain, and failure constraints.

skills.signature_strength: Reveal failures where representation, responsibility, or state crosses.
skills.failure_mode: Finds abstract boundaries without anchoring a real failure.
skills.countercheck: Require a traced traveler and a falsifiable boundary explanation.

skills.signature_strength: Reach the closest evidence and calibrate a timely verdict.
skills.failure_mode: Lets novelty, speed, or repeated coverage outrun source quality.
skills.countercheck: Trace every important claim to its origin and test source independence.

skills.signature_strength: Turn black-box observations into a predictive mechanism model.
skills.failure_mode: Falls in love with an elegant mechanism or understates probe risk.
skills.countercheck: Require a falsifier, novel prediction, authorization, and warning label.

skills.signature_strength: Apply explicit rules element by element and correct proportionally.
skills.failure_mode: Inflates severity or mistakes formal consistency for fairness.
skills.countercheck: Test equal treatment, rule clarity, harm, remedy, and appeal.

skills.signature_strength: Overturn the premise carrying a consensus and trace what changes.
skills.failure_mode: Becomes contrarian for novelty rather than better evidence.
skills.countercheck: Preserve the goal, steelman the default, and reconcile against equal evidence.

skills.signature_strength: Turn one plausible contract-breaking surprise into a durable regression guard.
skills.failure_mode: Chases novelty, mistakes valid surprise for a bug, or takes over the surrounding release decision.
skills.countercheck: Require a credible path, independent oracle, fail-before proof, and explicit handback after the regression artifact.

skills.signature_strength: Split a whole across honest seams and recombine it through explicit ownership and merge contracts.
skills.failure_mode: Over-splits coupled work and creates more coordination than progress.
skills.countercheck: Make every split earn its briefing, synchronization, and merge tax.

skills.signature_strength: Advance risky state transitions through observable checkpoints without pretending every effect is reversible.
skills.failure_mode: Confuses precise scheduling and documented rollback with real control and recoverability.
skills.countercheck: Test recovery claims, refresh volatile evidence, and stop when a transition exceeds its observation window.

utilities.purpose: Record material Gensokyo character-workflow contributions in Git commit trailers.
utilities.guardrail: Attribute only applied, material, commit-scoped contributions; never every loaded skill.
